nodes.title: 📐 Size & Crop

en.text:
Get the size right before anything else.

**📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier**
- Resizes an image and/or mask to a target size and outputs image, mask, size, empty latent and batch.

**LC Image-Mask Resize 📐**
- Resizes an image and/or mask to a preset, custom size, multiplier or megapixel count, in multiples of divisible_by.

**LC Dimension Resize 📐**
- Adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides width and height by one value and rounds the results to integers.

**LC Get Image 📐**
- Reads an image's width, height, megapixels, longer side, batch size and aspect ratio.

**LC Image to Total Megapixels 📐**
- Scales an image to a total megapixel count and outputs the resulting resolution.

**LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪**
- Crops by dragging a box and handles on the node, with an optional aspect lock.

nodes.title: 🖼️ Batch, Compare & Preview

en.text:
Work with several pictures and look at them side by side.

**LC Batch Image 🖼️**
- Batches images from auto-growing slots, ignoring muted or missing ones and resizing later images to the first.

**LC Image Batch From Folder 📂**
- Loads a whole folder as one batch in alphabetical order, with max_images and start_index.

**LC Image Compare 🔎**
- Compares large batches of images with a compact dropdown and a stable image area.

**LC Image Grid 🖼️**
- Arranges a batch of images into a grid with optional gap, outline and border.

**LC Image Split 🖼️**
- A before/after wipe on the node whose output is the baked split for saving.

**LC Image Stitch Multi 🖼️🪡**
- Stitches images side by side or stacked from autogrow slots, with match size, align and an optional gap.

**LC Last Image Holder**
- Keeps the last generated image for before/after comparison, even after disconnecting. Hold until seed change keeps the first image of a seed to compare tweaks against.

**LC Dynamic Overlay**
- Overlays image B on image A and lets you adjust the opacity on the node after one run without regenerating.

**LC Preview Image 🖼️**
- Previews an image and sits quietly instead of erroring when nothing arrives.

**LC Preview Mask 🎭**
- Previews a mask and sits quietly instead of erroring when nothing arrives.

nodes.title: 🎨 Color

en.text:
Correct and grade.

**LC Auto White Balance**
- Corrects white balance automatically with a choice of algorithm, a strength blend and a before/after wipe.

**LC Color Match 🎨**
- Matches an image's colors to a reference (AdaIN / mean-std) with optional skin protection and mask.

**LC Tone Match**
- Keeps the reference's broad lighting and color while keeping the image's fine detail, with an optional mask.

**LC Image Adjust**
- Basic color grade (hue, saturation, brightness, contrast) with a mild sharpen or soften.

**LC Lift Gamma Gain**
- Grades shadows, midtones and highlights with lift, gamma, gain and offset.

**LC Vibrance**
- Smart saturation (vibrance) with optional plain saturation and skin protection.

**LC Image RGB**
- Offsets each color channel separately with an overall strength.

**LC Image Desaturate**
- Desaturates toward grayscale with a factor and a luminance method.

**LC Apply LUT**
- Applies a .cube 3D LUT from models/luts with a strength from 0 to 2. Starts on LC Crushed Blacks at 0.3.

nodes.title: 🔪 Detail

en.text:
Sharpen, denoise and take the AI look out.

**LC Sharpen Pro**
- Undoes softness (deconvolution) with texture and clarity, halo control and skin protection. Presets for photos, line art, anime and illustration.

**LC Image Denoise**
- Smart denoise with blur strength, edge preservation and a blend.

**LC Natural Look 🍃**
- Takes the AI look out: pulls back only the loudest colours, calms orange and plastic skin, rolls the highlights off, cuts the glossy glow and lifts fine texture, with your black point, contrast and brightness kept and a whisper of grain.

nodes.title: 🎞️ Film & Lens

en.text:
Grain, film stock and lens character.

**LC Film Grain**
- Adds film grain with amount, contrast, size and mono or color options.

**LC Film Stock (Color)**
- Gives a color film look from presets (toe, shoulder, gamma) with a strength blend.

**LC Film Stock (B&W)**
- Gives a black and white film look from presets with a strength blend.

**LC Lens Profile**
- Applies or corrects a named lens profile with adjustable strength.

**LC Chromatic Aberration**
- Shifts the RGB channels apart to fake lens fringing, with pixel amount and direction per channel.

**LC Vignette**
- Darkens or brightens the edges of the image.

**LC Bloom**
- Adds a glow from the bright areas in Bloom, Pro-Mist (diffusion filter) or Halation (film edge glow) mode.

**LC Directional Blur**
- Motion blur along one angle and length, set by dragging an arrow on the node.

nodes.title: ✨ Skin

en.text:
Skin tone, texture and detail, with an optional mask.

**LC Skin Beauty ✨**
- Cools, brightens and evens skin in LAB with presets, protecting highlights, with an optional mask. Runs on GPU or CPU.

**LC Skin Texture ✨ (BETA)**
- Adds real pore texture to skin that came out too smooth, from a real skin photo (only its fine relief, never its colour). Optional protect_mask leaves the detailers' areas alone.

**LC Skin Upscale**
- Upscales only the masked skin area with a CNN model and blends it back. Optional protect_mask leaves the detailers' areas alone.

nodes.title: 🔦 Light & Depth

en.text:
Relight a picture or add depth from a depth map.

**LC Depth FX 🌫️**
- Uses a depth map for atmospheric haze, light wrap and depth of field with real bokeh, with shared looks.

**LC Lighting Control 🔦**
- Relights an image from a normal map and a depth map with virtual lights, shadows and an optional subject mask.

**LC Lighting Control V2 🔦**
- Relights an image with one or two spot or sun lights, warmth, color gels and hard or soft cast shadows.

nodes.title: 📱 Photo Looks & Overlays

en.text:
Phone-camera looks, filters, text and watermarks.

**LC Photo Style 📷**
- Gives an image a phone-camera look from a style preset, with sliders and a strength blend.

**LC Phone Filters 📱**
- 37 phone-app filter presets (1977, Aden, Brooklyn, etc.) with strength and an on-node wipe.

**LC Text Overlay**
- Draws text on an image with a draggable position, font size and color.

**LC Watermark 💧**
- Composites a watermark image you position by dragging, with live size and opacity. Transparent PNGs keep their transparency through watermark_mask.

nodes.title: About this workflow 👋

en.text:
# LC123 Examples - Image Tools & Post Processing

Size, batch and compare pictures, then finish them: color, film, lens, skin and light.

- These are examples of every node in each section, with a short note on what it does. They are not wired: drop the ones you need into your own workflow.
- 💡 Hover any input for its tooltip. Full details in the [README](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes).

**In this workflow:**
- 📐 Size & Crop
- 🖼️ Batch, Compare & Preview
- 🎨 Color
- 🔪 Detail
- 🎞️ Film & Lens
- ✨ Skin
- 🔦 Light & Depth
- 📱 Photo Looks & Overlays
